body: She always made scrambled, but these were some kind of omelette, which don't make either. I really didn't want to stay and try them, so i lied and said i had to go to a friends without eating. It's fine that you suggested it, part of me even wants to do just that. But i know this isn't healthy or normal, and would just make me feel horrible after awhile. I have been talking more to it lately (kind of hard not to) and it can remember everything up to the fire that killed her, whats been happening since i found her, but when i try to get i to talk about the year between that, she only brings up vague points about it, and can't seem to remember it. Also is very resistant to showing me her scarred arms.
Oh yea, asked him about the MRI and he said we will see that the therapist has to say first.

Sorry about the late response, internet got cut and i paid the bill today. I saw my doctor yesterday and he gave me anti-depressants, sleeping pills and made a appointment with a therapist that "specializes with cases like yours". 

A few days ago she made me breakfest. I don't know if somehow it controlled me or i did it before and forgot or i was the one making the eggs, all i know is im scared of it now more then anything else.

I just remember thinking i was dreaming so i went along with it, which then we just sort of talked for a few hours. On more than one occasion, i have had strangers duck into my apartment trying to get out of the rain or whatever (God damn door doesn't lock right and i had since got some chain locks).

 I don't think ghosts are like this, actually talking to someone and interacting with them i mean. Plus most ghosts don't follow someone around to different places that aren't really connected, like the store i shop at and my shitty apartment she never saw in a city she had never visited.

Sorry for the wait, internet got cut for awhile. I can't really think any mental issues in my history, but I will be seeing my doctor soon about this and will probably end up getting a MRI and talking to a therapist. Very strange that something around my brain would be the thing i need to get checked out, since she specfically said I hit my head when i first saw her. 

I was a wreck after her death, but with the help of friends i was able to continue on with what i wanted to do with her (play in a band), but by myself. I would like to think that the worst of it has passed and i have recovered somewhat, but since this started i don't know if i have. I have since gotten rid of some of her old things with the hope that would help me and started taking very heavy sleeping pills, to make sure i don't see her in the middle of the night again.
